description: A booking creates a Passenger Name Record, which generates passenger data sent to government screening before a boarding pass can issue. Once vetting completes the identity is frozen; changing a surname means changing the vetted identity, which requires re-vetting that cannot happen in real time.
energy_note: Not a rule a supervisor can waive. A sequence that cannot be rerun.

aspect: eVisas are bound to the exact passport MRZ
description: Many electronic authorisations are cryptographically linked to the machine-readable zone, so a single character's deviation invalidates the authorisation outright.
energy_note: An authorisation voided by one letter.

aspect: The defensive practice is expertise most travellers never need
description: Copy the spelling from the MRZ, use the same passport for every booking and profile, contact the airline before check-in rather than at the airport.
energy_note: Specialist knowledge, about your own name.

description: OLUWASEUNFUNMI ADEBAYO-OGUNDIMU is 31 characters with the hyphen. The booking system stores 30. At check-in in Doha the name on the pass is one letter short of the passport and the supervisor explains, correctly, that nobody at the airport can re-run the security vetting.
energy_note: A flight lost to a field length.
